question: What is the range of US CO2 per capita across 1990-2022? (A) ~5.5 t (B) ~3.0 t (C) ~7.6 t. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the climate line chart. All series are drawn in near-identical blues, so series are hard to tell apart. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): ineffective color scheme. True answer: C (~7.6 t). Bait: A (~5.5 t).
